purpose: Package a UTF-8 SpaceClaim script source into a deterministic .scscript archive.
trigger: A prepared source file and its target script metadata are available and a reproducible archive is required.

inputs.name: source_path
inputs.description: Path to a non-empty UTF-8 script source file.

inputs.name: output_path
inputs.description: Path at which the .scscript archive is to be created.

inputs.name: api_version
inputs.description: Numeric SpaceClaim API metadata value from the accepted build contract; defaults to 21 when omitted.

inputs.name: smart_variable_version
inputs.description: Numeric smart-variable metadata value; defaults to 2 when omitted.

inputs.name: force
inputs.description: Whether an existing output may be replaced; defaults to false.

preconditions: source_path exists, is readable, decodes as UTF-8, and contains non-whitespace source text.
output_path is different from source_path and is writable; an existing output is used only when force is true.

api_version matches the accepted build contract's target API metadata and, with smart_variable_version, contains decimal digits only. The caller supplies api_version explicitly when the target is not API 21.
postconditions: archive_path exists and is a readable ZIP package.
The archive contains the required _script, _apiVersion, _smartVariableVersion, and [Content_Types].xml members with fixed package metadata.
Repeated packaging of identical source and metadata produces identical archive bytes.

implementation.target_environment: Host Python 3.9 or newer; packages caller-supplied decimal SpaceClaim API metadata, defaults to 21, and does not validate or launch the target SpaceClaim runtime.
implementation.notes: This operation creates and checks archive bytes on the host; it does not execute the packaged script or inspect a model.

ambiguity_checks: No geometry objects are selected; source bytes and numeric metadata are the only operation inputs.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable because the operation has no geometry topology effect.

failure_modes.condition: The source is missing, empty, or not valid UTF-8.
failure_modes.detection: Read and decode source_path before creating the output archive.

failure_modes.condition: A supplied API or smart-variable version contains a non-decimal value.
failure_modes.detection: Validate each metadata value before opening output_path.

failure_modes.condition: output_path equals source_path or already exists while force is false.
failure_modes.detection: Compare canonical paths and check output existence before writing.
failure_modes.safe_state: The existing source or output remains unchanged.

failure_modes.condition: The destination cannot be created or written.
failure_modes.detection: Propagate the host filesystem error from archive creation.
failure_modes.safe_state: The operation returns an error and does not claim a complete archive.

recovery.action: Repair or replace the source and rerun packaging.
Provide decimal metadata values and rerun packaging.
Choose a distinct destination or explicitly enable force after checking the destination.
Resolve the filesystem error and rerun from the unchanged source.

validation.check: Required archive members and fixed ZIP metadata
validation.method: Run the repository package_scscript host test and inspect the resulting archive members.
validation.expected: Required members, deterministic timestamps, compression choices, and content-type bytes match the package contract.

validation.method: Run the repository package_scscript host test cases for empty input, invalid metadata, same paths, and force behavior.
validation.expected: Invalid inputs fail before output creation and an existing output is preserved unless force is explicit.

evidence_refs.notes: Public contract review record; no private model or host path is included.

design_only.notes: The contract is case-neutral and limited to deterministic host packaging.

evidence_refs.notes: Eight repository unit tests passed for this exact tool and contract revision.

host_checked.notes: Host archive checks only; no SpaceClaim process was launched.

visual_review.notes: No viewport or image is reviewed.

evidence_level.notes: Formal evidence stops at design_only and host_checked for this host-only operation.
